text: RESULTS: Chest X-Ray Findings: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrates or obvious masses. Based on your history of smoking, occupational dust exposure, and symptoms of dyspnea, dry cough, and wheezing with expiration, these findings are consistent with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).
